# pmon_roles (Data Source)

Every access-control role, including the shipped `system:` ones that cannot be managed as resources. A role grants nothing by itself; policies decide what holding it means.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pmon_roles" "all" {}

output "role_names" {
  value = [for r in data.pmon_roles.all.roles : r.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) The roles, as pmon reports them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) What holding the role means.
- `id` (Number) pmon's internal id.
- `name` (String) Role name, as Cedar refers to it: `Role::"<name>"`.
